business_summary: Oxford Industries, Inc., an apparel company, designs, sources, markets, and distributes lifestyle products worldwide. The company offers men's and women's sportswear and related products under the Tommy Bahama brand; and women's and girls' dresses and sportswear, scarves, bags, jewelry, and belts, as well as children's apparel, swim, footwear, and licensed products under the Lilly Pulitzer brand. It also licenses Tommy Bahama brand for various products, such as indoor and outdoor furniture, beach chairs, bedding and bath linens, fabrics, leather goods and gifts, headwear, hosiery, sleepwear, shampoo, toiletries, fragrances, cigar accessories, resort operations, and other products; Johnny Was brand that designs, sources, markets and distributes upscale collections of affordable luxury, artisan-inspired bohemian apparel, accessories and home goods; and Lilly Pulitzer for stationery and gift products, home furnishing products, and eyewear. The company distributes its products through southerntide.com, thebeaufortbonnetcompany.com, duckhead.com, and jackrogersusa.com; and specialty retailers, as well as offers product under the Southern Tide, TBBC, Duck Head and Jack Rogers brand name. It offers products through its retail stores, department stores, specialty stores, multi-branded e-commerce retailers, off-price retailers, and other retailers, as well as e-commerce sites. The company operates brand-specific full-price retail stores; Tommy Bahama food and beverage locations; and Tommy Bahama outlet stores. Oxford Industries, Inc. was founded in 1942 and is headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia.
business_summary_ko: Oxford Industries, Inc.는 의류 회사로 전 세계적으로 라이프스타일 제품을 디자인, 공급, 판매 및 유통합니다. 이 회사는 Tommy Bahama 브랜드로 남성 및 여성 스포츠웨어와 관련 제품을 제공합니다. 여성 및 여아용 드레스와 운동복, 스카프, 가방, 보석류, 벨트는 물론 아동복, 수영복, 신발, Lilly Pulitzer 브랜드의 라이센스 제품도 포함됩니다. 또한 실내 및 실외 가구, 해변용 의자, 침구 및 목욕 린넨, 직물, 가죽 제품 및 선물, 모자, 양말류, 잠옷, 샴푸, 세면도구, 향수, 시가 액세서리, 리조트 운영 및 기타 제품과 같은 다양한 제품에 대해 Tommy Bahama 브랜드 라이선스를 부여합니다. Johnny Was 브랜드는 합리적인 가격의 럭셔리, 장인의 영감을 받은 보헤미안 의류, 액세서리 및 가정용품의 고급 컬렉션을 디자인, 공급, 판매 및 유통합니다. 문구류, 선물용품, 홈퍼니싱 제품, 안경 등을 취급하는 Lilly Pulitzer가 있습니다. 회사는 southtide.com, thebeaufortbonnetcompany.com, duckhead.com 및 jackrogersusa.com을 통해 제품을 배포합니다. 전문 소매점뿐만 아니라 Southern Tide, TBBC, Duck Head 및 Jack Rogers 브랜드 이름으로 제품을 제공합니다.
